about_p1: Our work covers tires and wheels and brakes for homes and businesses that need it done right.
svc_hero_h1: The tyres work we take on

services.title: Tires and wheels
services.body: Fitting, balancing and rotation on the machine, with the weights set where they belong.

services.title: Brakes
services.body: Pads, rotors and calipers are checked as a set and the worn ones come off beside the new ones, so you can see what was actually changed.

evidence.text: The folks there got the car in right away, replaced the front brakes and rotated the tires in about an hour.
evidence.also: Big shout out for fixing my brakes on a holiday.

reviews.author: Kevin Anderson
reviews.text: On a trip with my youth group and a tire blew out on our minibus. Stranded and Doyle’s came to the rescue! They got us up and running! Highly recommend!!!!!

reviews.author: Charlotte Tindall
reviews.text: Fantastic! Got a low tire light on our way from Ky to SC and Doyle’s saved the day! They actually found 2 nails and had us patched up and back on the road in record time. We appreciate their knowledge and availability taking care of our issue. 10/10

reviews.author: Wesley Miller
reviews.text: Has a small part for boat and they were able to repair it quick and got the boat back on the lake. Great guys, good service. Heard them interact with a few customers, they were treated well and prices were very fair! 10/10

reviews.author: Ikran Asomani
reviews.text: These guys are amazing, so kind and professional! I was driving to Atlanta when I got a slow leak, and they replaced my tire quickly and at a super reasonable price. Excellent service and great people. Highly recommend! I just wish they were located where I live!

reviews.author: Amanda Diller
reviews.text: The people over at Doyles did us a solid. We are from Indiana and was leaving GA to head home and our cv axle busted. Doyles (skeeter) had us in there the next morning (it broke on highway in the middle of the night). We got to the shop where everyone was so loving and caring and understanding. Skeeter got it fixed and we went to drive off and our cv axle busted again. Skeeter worked on our truck (6 hours) to get us back on the road and get us back home . I highly recommend this place for anyone around this area that needs a hard working honest auto shop. Skeeter wish we lived closer for you to work on our vehicles.

reviews.author: heather johnson
reviews.text: Just visited for new tires, never an exciting responsibility. These guys were helpful, friendly and truly wanted to provide a comfortable experience. The shop was organized, office had been redone and the waiting room was clean and inviting. We started using Doyle's after a competitor's tire blew prematurely and we tried to explain. It seemed questionable and maybe the manufacturer would want to be notified? The competitor instead accused us of lying, that my husband hit something. He was traveling at that time and driving many hours. The tire was fairly new. That experience was quite unpalatable but led us to Doyle's. We loved them from the start. Good ole fashioned sweet people. Was surprised to learn the original owners stepped down ( will be missed, loved them!!)but the new guys have seemed to take the ball and are running to win!! They are worth your time, no disappointment here. Might even venture to say fun!!

reviews.author: Ari R
reviews.text: Found out we had a bad tire on our way through TN back up north with 8 hours left til home. Needed a tire in a pinch and they found us a used one for a great price. They got us in and out super quick and back on the road! Friendly and great customer service

reviews.author: Abby West
reviews.text: These guys were a life saver. A tire blew out on our trailer and we were 1.5 hours from home. These guys closed at 2pm and we pulled in at 1:45. They had us fixed and back on the road in less than 15 minutes. Super grateful for their help and great customer service.

reviews.author: Beth Fox
reviews.text: They went above & beyond to get me 2 tires delivered so I can leave town on time. When I arrived to get the tires mounted I was in & out in 25mins. Fantastic, friendly service

reviews.author: Lindsay Thomas
reviews.text: The tire place is under new ownership and management I visited today. Everything was great. Service was great. Quick prices were also amazing. I’d highly recommend stopping by here. They were able to fit me in on a busy Saturday. Thank you so much for the service.

reviews.author: BTDT Knoxville
reviews.text: They had the tire I needed to get my work truck back on the road quickly. The owner even came out and helped get me out fast. The price was right and the service was quick and courteous.

reviews.author: Katherine Guerrero
reviews.text: The manager/owner was super helpful and nice. Gave us recommendations on good local food spots to try. Was definitely lucky to bump Into this tire shop ((:

reviews.author: Grant Lucas
reviews.text: Nice people, but lazy. Dropped my car off Saturday to have 1 tire replaced then aligned, I was told it would be done by Monday. It was not done till Wednesday evening. Then they also only replaced the tire and did not align it because of “problems” but as I can tell the problems should not stop them from alignment. Good prices but poor efficiency.

reviews.author: Christen VanEtten
reviews.text: DO NOT GO HERE. Used to, this was the place to go to get good tires, fast, and for a good price. This place has gone downhill fast, the employees have no idea where to put jacks on cars, they don’t know how to put on rims that have lug nuts instead of studs. I personally had an experience at this place that has overall lead me to 3k in damages on my car, and my tires have been flat since I had them put on. The day after I purchased four new tires they were flat. I also paid with cash, and they have a sign in the lobby that says “3% discount when paid in cash” which they do not honor. I had a blowout on the interstate due to my tires not holding air, causing damage to both rear rims which are 1k a piece. An employee at this place put a jack on my car on the body, and not the frame causing it to go through it, and the entire car dropped to the ground. Just for understanding, my car comes with jack pads installed on four points under the car that say “JACK PAD”. They broke my side skirt, mudflap, and sensor housing box inside my wheel well. This place deserves to be shut down, go to eagle tire. Even if it’s more expensive it’ll save you in the long run. This place has been a nightmare in my life. Yet they are supposed to be “family friends”.

reviews.author: Logan Vaughn
reviews.text: I took my truck in for an alignment at 9:48 in the morning and they told me it would take about 3 hours. I got my truck back at 4:30, and had to miss my son’s doctors appointment, not to mention it is worse than it was before I took it here. Also, I guess they really wanted to find something in my glove department and my dash because there are finger prints everywhere including the sunvisors. I will not be bringing them anymore business again.

reviews.author: Doug Lawson
reviews.text: There's a reason half the time you can't even get in the parking lot at Doyle's Tire. They're good people.

reviews.author: Michelle Florentine
reviews.text: Ended up with two flat tires and a damaged rim on our trailer while visiting the local off road park. Fortunately we had left with two spares to get us to here, but not having any options for another spare "just in case" Left us worried. Headed down and these folks were the 2nd place we stopped (first place didn't have any in the size rim or tire we needed and to order them would be past our leave date.) Sure glad we found this shop! Had two brand new tires AND a replacement rim for us in stock. Prices were reasonable, and their customer service was amazing. Had a good time chatting with them, and so glad they were able to get us back on the road with peace of mind. Real life savers...can't recommend them enough!

reviews.author: Sarah
reviews.text: Fairly new to the area and another shop told me Doyle's would take care of me for a tire repair that I needed. It is privately owned and that's where I like my money to go, so that was nice. The owners were beyond kind. Theu looked very busy, as all stalls were full. They got my car in with in minutes. The employees were great and answered the many questions I bothered them with :) Every single person I encountered was very down to earth and worked diligently. I tend to have one place I go for everything and don't vary, and recently having moved here, I didnt have one yet, but now I do. The price was shockingly good. To the point that I even asked "are you sure?" Great place. Beyond impressed.

reviews.author: Russ Schwinge
reviews.text: I had some lift work done to my Yukon and also bought new tires. This place did the best job balancing my tires. They are so friendly as well. Price is very good also. But to me it is not the price nor the people being friendly. It is how good the service is. And I’m here to tell you. I live in Powell TN and have tons of tire places to go to but this place is the best that’s why I have brought all 3 of my cars to them even though it’s so far from my house.

reviews.author: Eric E
reviews.text: My daughter and her boyfriend were traveling from Atlanta to Cleveland OH to visit us for a long weekend. Their car developed problems with the front brakes. They just happened to be near Doyle’s Tire Shop and stopped in. The folks there got the car in right away, replaced the front brakes and rotated the tires in about an hour. Thanks to everyone there! Great job and great service!

reviews.author: Mike Aiken
reviews.text: Excellent tire service here! I've bought several sets of truck tires from these folks. Reasonable prices. AND they are very accomodating when you need a quick repair on your commercial mower. They had me back on the job in 15 minutes!

reviews.author: Nick McPherson
reviews.text: Took my truck last Monday for a mount and balance on front and an alignment. Took it back Tuesday evening cause there was nothing aligned... Put my keys where I was told and they were ran over and when my wife got it the next day it was no better. Took it today to another shop and they said there was nothing aligned at all. So I couldn't drive my truck for a week and spent another 100 to get it done right. Used to love Doyle's now I don't trust getting work done there

reviews.author: Doug Smith
reviews.text: God Bless America and Happy 4th of July! Big shout out for fixing my brakes on a holiday. Thanks for coming in clutch

reviews.author: Meagan Woodward
reviews.text: Their straight crooks! Mt mother has 3 kids no help from the state or anyone else. She owns her own business and most know locally-owned business's is hard to keep afloat these days! She went to get new tires and front breaks done on her car. When she returns the same day to get the car she was given the total she pulls out all her cash and counts out the money putting the rest on the counter top to hand him the total and retrieving her reciept. With 3 kids the youngest being 6 gets distracted she rab her wallet and heads out the door. Down the rd realizes what she'd done and cleaned the.... they tell her that they hadn't seen no money and didn't know what she was talking about. My mother has worked 23 straight yrs without taking a week off for a vacation! This week was the first week she had done just that and with the total of 700 dollars this company wasn't honest about now has barley 100 to her name till she gets back to qork! I would seriously watch the totals and making sure u add up the prices ur self to make sure u wasn't scammed! Of they can't be honest about someone leaving 700 dollars on their counter what else would they lie about?!? I think we're gonna take this into bigger hands! Just please watch these people!

reviews.author: Scott Koronich
reviews.text: Family run business where you are put first in customer service! They don’t pick and choose what jobs they will do (like the guys next door to them) they just get the job done at a fair price. Great people!

reviews.author: Sheena Carden
reviews.text: I took my truck there Thursday afternoon and they have had it for a week! I don't know if they had to Order the part I needed or if there were alot of people in front of me? They never did feel me in.... All I know is I've been w/o a vehicle for a week.

reviews.author: Yourbanker
reviews.text: Hands down the best customer service in town! Great service with fair prices. They've been servicing me and my family since 2008

reviews.author: Steve Steverson
reviews.text: Doyle's is an awesome place to go for tire and breaks needs. Always friendly and very fair priced. I can't tell you how many times they have saved me money, and the qkrk is always quality. They always go the extra mile for my mom, too. Often doing courtesy things that most tire/mechanic shops wouldn't dare do. Generally for no charge if something simple, too. You can tell the owner is a true Christian ad not a pretend one. You will get treated fairly there, and have no worries whatsoever of being over charged/gouged.

reviews.author: Daniel Mills
reviews.text: Called on Monday and the Lady said we don't have any in at this time but I can have them here tomorrow. Called on Tuesday and the gentleman told me that the tires was not in but would be in at 2. Got there at 2:30 and was gone by 3. Super nice people and they took care of the job fast. Will go back!!!

reviews.author: cheesecake
reviews.text: God bless them! They didn’t have any tires in set our size but were so concerned about us getting home they gave us a used tire to keep us safe. Awesome people

reviews.author: Becky Morris
reviews.text: Only place I go for tire needs. Skeeter has always been fair prices an gets the job done Updated Was only place we went but after dealing with the young kid crew goofing off ,throwing bottles I could no longer deal with the outcome.

reviews.author: Thomas Evans
reviews.text: These guys are great! Nice folks to deal with and they do great work, just a nice place to get work done that has guys that have been around cars and trucks for a long time, not a bunch of kids that have a uniform but no experience.

reviews.author: Rick Dennis
reviews.text: Quick service and fair pricing. Stopped in to get a trailer tire repaired and another replaced. He ordered them in and had them the same day

reviews.author: Bill Rose
reviews.text: Doyle's is great. I got the best price and great service. It was way cheaper than everyone else quoted for 4 Cooper tires for my truck!

reviews.author: Lynn Szczepanik
reviews.text: The most polite and reassuring folks I have ever met. I would recommend this place for super prices and great work. Thank you Skeeter for the help.

reviews.author: Mike cooke
reviews.text: Good people and good prices on tires, my dad and i own a shop in south clinton and i can get tires at Doyles for close to what i can get them through our shop and its more convenient for me being i live in Campbell co.

reviews.author: Catherine Brookshire
reviews.text: Came in with a bent rim from the interstate they were very helpful and wonderful!! You guys are amazing highly recommend to anyone in that area

reviews.author: Jaime Messer
reviews.text: Highly recommend Doyle’s! Skeeter and Gary were both very friendly and helpful. Very impressed with the speed and efficiency of their service!

reviews.author: Russ Figueira
reviews.text: Good service, staff very helpful. They go up and above to help customers. Will not sell you what you don't need. Very honest Christian owners.

reviews.author: Melissa Jessie
reviews.text: I would like to say thank you to doyles tires they done a bunch of work for me and done a amazing job especially skeeter I would highly recommend them.

reviews.author: McKinsey Breeding
reviews.text: I've been going to Doyle's for years, and have always had a good experience. Sometimes the wait is long, but it's definitely worth it.

reviews.author: steve tackett
reviews.text: Good, fair price on tires. Timely installation at no extra charge. Good family business to deal with. Thanks Skeeter

reviews.author: Cody Of Athens
reviews.text: They are not closed, ignore that. This is one of the best, most inexpensive, and most honest car places I've ever been to. They've always done right by us. Highly suggested.

reviews.author: patricia harrell
reviews.text: Those guys are so good at what they do. I wouldn't go anywhere else for tires, or any repairs on any vehicle I own

reviews.author: Jillian G
reviews.text: Don't like that they don't do appointments and seems to run a bit hap hazzardly but do go above AMA beyond in other areas and have always been very friendly.

reviews.author: Steven Santiago
reviews.text: Been using this store for 27 years with not one complaint on products or services and i will continue to do so in the future.

reviews.author: Daron Thrower
reviews.text: Had new rotors and break shoes put on my pickup truck and the guys did a great job , and didn't take long at all , thanks guys.

reviews.author: DAPHNE SAUNDERS
reviews.text: Thank you Skeeter for helping clear up that Google connected me with Eagle Tires, not Doyle! I'll be seeing you in the future!!

reviews.author: Matthew hughes
reviews.text: Been going here for years and always got good service. The new owner is really nice and willing to help out.
